subject: Quarterly readiness: renewal risk register & exec attention
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quarterly readiness: renewal risk register & exec attention

Team — attaching the compiled renewal risk register for Acme ahead of next week's QBR. This covers customer health indicators, open procurement blockers, and suggested exec-level asks. I pulled the latest notes from CS and finance and highlighted items I think require leadership visibility.

Top-level summary:
- Current renewal: $2.1M ARR (expiring Feb 2027)
- Health score: 58 (usage plateau + two support tickets about latency spikes)
- Primary risk drivers: procurement delay (SOW redlines), perceived feature parity against competitor, and token cost sensitivity after pilot scale-up

Requested by EOD Tuesday:
1) Review the attached renewal-risk-register.xlsx and add any missing risk mitigations (column: proposed_action).
2) Confirm which exec to route each ask to (CEO/Head of Sales/Head of Product).
3) Approve three short talking points for the QBR exec slide (I drafted a stub in exec-talking-points.docx).

Attachments: renewal-risk-register.xlsx (Excel), customer-health-summary.pdf (PDF), exec-talking-points.docx (Word)

Thanks — I will aggregate inputs and surface a final exec brief on Thursday.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly readiness: renewal risk register & exec attention

On Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 08:12 AM Aditya Rao wrote:
> Team — attaching the compiled renewal risk register for Acme ahead of next week's QBR...

Thanks for pulling this together, Aditya. I added two rows in the register for: (1) persistent latency incidents during peak batch windows (we have three SE tickets open, incident IDs included), and (2) a request from Acme's ML infra team for private deployment options because of PII pipeline requirements.

Quick notes from CS:
- Renewal champion (Molly) is favorable but procurement is moving slowly — they asked for our SOC 2 attestation and an audit log sample, which CS has provided but procurement wants a signed letter from security.
- They asked about dedicated capacity pricing for predictable usage; pricing is the main negotiation lever right now.

Proposed exec asks (my suggestions):
- Ask Head of Security to sign a brief letter confirming SOC 2 scope + audit log availability (one-paragraph).
- Ask Head of Sales to authorize a one-time onboarding credit of up to $25k if procurement signs within 30 days.

I left comments in exec-talking-points.docx and flagged two slides for potential escalations.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly readiness: renewal risk register & exec attention

Adding commercial context.
- Current ask from Acme procurement: fixed 12-month commitment with a cap on overage pricing. They want a clause to limit token-based overages.
- Negotiation status: legal has redlined the SOW; key open items are liability cap and data residency language (they want EU data controls for a subset of traffic).

Options to de-risk (recommended):
1) Offer a pilot-to-commit discount path: 10% one-time credit on first invoice + an agreed cadence to revisit usage tiers at month 6.
2) Approve the one-time onboarding credit Neha suggested (caps to $25k) — helps speed procurement.
3) Provide a short appendix committing to an audit-readiness walkthrough with our Security PM and their SREs.

If leadership is comfortable with option 1+2 we can close faster. I can draft the commercial amendment if given the green light.

-Priyom
Director of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: Exec brief for Acme QBR — please review (short list for leadership)

Laura / leadership — I consolidated internal inputs into three exec-facing asks for the QBR slide and flagged a few items that need your sign-off. The attached exec-talking-points.docx has full wording; below are the one-liners we should be prepared to speak to.

Exec asks (for CEO / Head of Sales / Head of Security):
- CEO: emphasize strategic partnership and Redwood's roadmap alignment; request exec help to remove procurement bottlenecks if needed.
- Head of Sales: approve $25k onboarding credit contingent on signed 12-month commit within 30 days.
- Head of Security: provide a one-paragraph letter confirming SOC 2 scope and availability of audit logs (we will share a template).

Risk register short highlights (for the slide deck):
- Procurement latency (high impact, medium likelihood) — mitigation: onboarding credit + sales escalation.
- Latency incidents (medium impact, medium likelihood) — mitigation: prioritized infra patch and a dedicated runbook for Acme traffic windows.
- Data residency ask (low impact, high complexity) — mitigation: offer targeted routing + appendix for EU-only payloads.

Please reply in-thread with any edits. I will finalize Friday and circulate to Molly and her procurement contact.

—Aditya
From: Molly Turner <molly.turner@acmeinc.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, procurement@acmeinc.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly readiness: renewal risk register & exec attention

Aditya / team — thank you for the thorough packet and the proposed asks. A couple quick updates from our side before the QBR: 

1) Procurement note: we need the legal appendix that clarifies overage caps and the proposed onboarding credit mechanics before the internal procurement review next Thursday. If you can send the draft amendment today it will materially speed things up.

2) Security: we do need a short signed letter confirming the SOC 2 scope; our security team expects the letter before they sign the SOW. Can your security lead share that template and an expected ETA?

3) Health: Molly (renewal champion) — we remain positive on the partnership, but the latency incidents during our peak batch windows are a blocker for our infra team; can Redwood confirm the timeline for the infra patch and whether we can pilot dedicated routing prior to renewal?

Let's plan to include the draft amendment and security letter as deliverables in tomorrow's QBR invite so our procurement can review live.

Best,
Molly Turner
Director of Engineering, Data Platform | Acme, Inc.
